name: Marketing Strategy
description: Produces a completed marketing strategy document using STP (Segmentation, Targeting, Positioning) framework with goals, audience definition, channel mix, budget allocation, and KPIs. Use when the user asks to create a marketing strategy, plan marketing for a product or company, define marketing goals and channels, or structure a marketing plan. Do NOT use for go-to-market launch planning (use go-to-market-strategy), single campaign planning (use campaign-planning), or brand positioning statement only (use brand-positioning).
